# Benin

The wealth gradients this library holds for Benin: first the values to give OG-Core, then the measurements behind them. New to the terms? See the [glossary](../glossary.md).

## What to use in OG-Core

| OG-Core input | Tilt | From |
|---|---|---|
| `fert_gradient` | **by age**, table below (fertility tilt −0.59 plus the [age offsets](../methods/fertility-by-age.md)) | DHS 2017 |
| `infmort_gradient` | **−0.52** | DHS 2017 |
| `mort_gradient` | **−0.66** (ages 15–60) | census 2013, own measurement |
| `imm_pctiles` | not covered by this library | — |

Every value is a **tilt** ([what that is](../glossary.md#tilt)). Convert it before passing it to OG-Core: `tilt / (100 × (1 − p))`, with p OG-Core's own rate at that age ([how](../methods/ogcore-units.md)).

**Fertility tilt by mother's age** (for `fert_gradient`; ages under 15 take the 15–19 value, 50 and over the 45–49 value):

| 15–19 | 20–24 | 25–29 | 30–34 | 35–39 | 40–44 | 45–49 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| −1.37 | −0.69 | −0.38 | −0.26 | −0.50 | −0.98 | −1.57 |

## Where these numbers come from

### Household surveys (DHS)

Latest survey, from [`data/gradient_library_latest.csv`](../../data/gradient_library_latest.csv). Earlier surveys are in `gradient_library.csv`.

| Measure | Survey | Tilt | Poorest-to-richest ratio | Poorest fifth → richest fifth |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Births per woman (TFR) | 2017 | **−0.59** | 1.6 | 7 · 6.2 · 6.1 · 5.3 · 4.2 |
| Infant deaths per 1,000 births (IMR) | 2017 | **−0.52** | 1.5 | 63 · 70 · 56 · 65 · 39 |
| Under-5 deaths per 1,000 births (U5MR) | 2017 | **−0.68** | 1.7 | 108 · 124 · 106 · 103 · 60 |

### Adult mortality from censuses

Tilts of the death rate across household wealth, from [`data/adult_mortality_gradients.csv`](../../data/adult_mortality_gradients.csv) ([method](../methods/adult-mortality.md)). Men and women together where available; the by-sex rows are in the [full table](../tables/adult_mortality.md). A blank cell had too few deaths to publish.

| Census | Ages 15–60 | 15–29 | 30–44 | 45–59 | 60–74 | Wealth groups | Deaths |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 2013 | **−0.66** |  |  |  |  | 4 | 1,555 |

Source: IPUMS International (Ruggles et al., doi:10.18128/D020.V7.7); original data: Institut National de la Statistique et de l'Analyse Economique, Benin.

## Notes

- The 2013 census records deaths since 1 January 2012 (~16 months to the May census) — fine for tilts, not levels. Capture against the national death count is ~35%, wealth-uniform, so it cancels out of the tilt.
